dct_title_s: Offshore Bathymetry (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This feature class contains bathymetric contour lines for offshore and ocean areas. The contour intervals are irregular.

Purpose: These data are intended for science researchers, students,and policy makers. The data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display seafloor topography, oceanographic information and associated areas of interest about the offshore areas of China, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
